requirement: Audit whether the existing IR can represent the major semantic families A-K present across a leveraged-finance agreement. For each: REPRESENTABLE_NOW / PARTIALLY_REPRESENTABLE / IR_GAP.
irVocabularyConfirmed: SCHEDULE (cases with arbitrary from/to + value, defaultValue) tiered/stepped structures
IRRule (capacityExpression, conditions, exceptions, entityScope/entityScopeExcluded, posture, action, dependsOn)
IRSharedCapacity + LEDGER_USAGE_REFERENCE.sharedCapRef for cross-rule basket sharing
UNSUPPORTED escape hatch, now attemptedStructure-preserving (prior session)

families.name: Definitions (metric definitions, ratios, pricing grids, thresholds, nested provisos)
families.mechanism: DIVIDE for ratios, SCHEDULE or IF-chains for pricing grids, IF/EVENT_ACTIVE for provisos.
families.empiricalProof: Real holdout data: B1's Applicable Liquidity Threshold (IF), A5's Secured Net Leverage Ratio's numerator (DIVIDE), B2's Applicable Rate (8-level IF chain, mostly well-typed).

families.name: Debt (fixed baskets, grower baskets, ratio debt, refinancing, permitted categories, conditions)
families.mechanism: Fixed=MONEY; grower=MAX(MONEY, MULTIPLY(PERCENT, METRIC_REFERENCE)); ratio-conditioned=UNLIMITED_CAPACITY gatedBy COMPARE, or a CovenantRule condition; refinancing principal+accrued interest+fees=ADD(RULE_REFERENCE(original principal), METRIC_REFERENCE(accrued interest), METRIC_REFERENCE(fees)).

families.name: Liens (fixed baskets, ratio liens, liens securing permitted debt, refinancing liens, equal-and-ratable)
families.mechanism: Same primitives as B; 'securing permitted debt' composes via RULE_REFERENCE to the debt-basket rule it secures.

families.name: Restricted Payments (fixed, builder baskets, leverage-based, equity proceeds, general basket, reclassification)
families.mechanism: Builder basket (cumulative net income + equity contributions - prior usage) maps directly onto the existing LEDGER_USAGE_REFERENCE primitive (already purpose-built for basket-usage tracking against a shared/accreting cap) composed with ADD/SUBTRACT.

families.name: Investments (permitted acquisitions, unrestricted subsidiaries, intercompany, general baskets, leverage-based)
families.mechanism: Same basket primitives as D, plus ENTITY_SCOPE_REFERENCE (already purpose-built for entity-class inclusion/exclusion) for unrestricted-subsidiary/acquisition-target scoping.

families.name: Asset Sales (permitted dispositions, reinvestment windows, mandatory prepayment triggers, thresholds, permitted transfers)
families.mechanism: A reinvestment WINDOW (e.g. '365 days to reinvest or a mandatory prepayment is triggered') maps plausibly onto EVENT_ACTIVE's own activeDuration field (already designed for bounded-duration event tracking) composed with a triggerCondition on whether reinvestment occurred, but this specific composition has NOT yet been empirically exercised against any real source region in this codebase's holdout history - flagged for direct testing in the whole-agreement reality check (13-14) rather than assumed.

families.name: Prepayments / Junior Debt (restricted debt payments, exceptions, refinancing, leverage tests)
families.mechanism: Same primitives as B/C - a prohibition/exception structure over a payment action, gated by COMPARE-based leverage tests.

families.name: Financial Covenants (leverage, coverage, liquidity, springing tests, step-downs)
families.mechanism: Springing test = EVENT_ACTIVE gating (e.g. revolver-usage-triggered); step-down over time = SCHEDULE keyed by date/fiscal-quarter ranges rather than ratio ranges - SCHEDULE's cases.from/to are untyped strings, not restricted to numeric ratio bands, so this composition is structurally available without a new node kind.

families.name: Reporting / Affirmative Covenants (deadlines, delivery requirements, event-triggered notices, certificates)
families.mechanism: The temporal primitives (DATE_LITERAL, DURING_PERIOD) and the IRRule model (posture/action/conditions) exist and plausibly compose to represent 'deliver financials within N days of quarter-end', but this family has NOT been exercised by any real holdout claim to date in this codebase's history (A1-A6/B1-B4 are all financial-metric or basket-shaped, not affirmative-obligation-shaped) - flagged as untested, not confirmed, and specifically included in the whole-agreement reality check's own required region mix (Section 21).

families.name: Event / Cure Mechanics (cure rights, cure periods, event-active conditions, temporal dependencies)
families.mechanism: EVENT_ACTIVE + activeDuration is purpose-built for exactly this shape.
families.empiricalProof: B4's real, paid holdout output already demonstrates a working dual-threshold cash-sweep-with-cure compilation (2 real MIN/SUBTRACT rules with real $50M/$115M thresholds and real citations) - the strongest existing empirical proof of any family in this audit.

families.name: Shared / Cross-Covenant Structure (shared caps, cross-references, reclassification, dependency graphs)
families.mechanism: IRSharedCapacity + LEDGER_USAGE_REFERENCE.sharedCapRef, RULE_REFERENCE, DEFINED_TERM_REFERENCE.resolvedDefinitionId, and IRDefinition.dependsOnTerms / IRRule.dependsOn are all pre-existing, first-class fields - not new. This is the exact machinery Section 23's own dependency-graph check will exercise empirically against real source.

summary.families: A,B,C,D,E,G,H,J,K = REPRESENTABLE_NOW (9); F,I = PARTIALLY_REPRESENTABLE, empirically untested rather than architecturally deficient (2); zero families show an outright IR_GAP requiring a new expression kind or schema redesign.

conclusion: No genuine general IR gap exists across any of the 11 named semantic families - eliminating IR_ARCHITECTURE_DECISION_REQUIRED as this mission's verdict on architectural grounds alone. The two PARTIALLY_REPRESENTABLE families (F, I) are flagged not because the IR structurally cannot represent them, but because this codebase has never empirically exercised those specific compositions against real source text - the whole-agreement reality check (13-14) is designed specifically to close that empirical gap, per the mission's own Section 21 instruction to test across provision families, not just definitions.
